label: Freelancer
terms_note: Freelancer.com API (contests 0.1). OAuth access token sent in the `freelancer-oauth-v1` header; per-endpoint rate limits answer HTTP 429.

discovery.auth: header freelancer-oauth-v1 (OAuth or personal access token)

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: OAuth access token with the `basic` scope (a personal access token from https://accounts.freelancer.com/settings/develop works); sent in the freelancer-oauth-v1 header.

adapter.rate_note: Docs: 'Each endpoint has a rate limit' (numbers unpublished; HTTP 429). One request per second.

discover.note: GET /contests/0.1/contests/active/ (query = space-separated terms matched against names and descriptions; limit/offset): active contests only, so `status` is not sent. `kind` is the contest type (e.g. guaranteed). prize (number) with currency, time_ended (Unix seconds), seo_url and jobs stay in `raw`.

get_competition.note: GET /contests/0.1/contests/{contest_id}/ (numeric id); the API answers {result: {contests: [contest]}}, and an unknown id is an empty list (invalid_input). prize, currency, time_ended and judging_period_days stay in `raw`.

not_offered.standings: Contests have no ranking endpoint; the holder rates and awards entries (entry statuses won/eliminated only).
not_offered.my_entries: GET /contests/0.1/entries/ (entrants[] filter) requires the advanced `fln:contest_manage` scope in addition to `basic`.
not_offered.enter: No join step: a contest is entered by submitting an entry (see submit).
not_offered.submit: POST /contests/0.1/entries/ submits an entry with its design files (multipart upload); binary uploads are out of scope.

evidence: host www.freelancer.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
live read without credentials: discover, get_competition returned data that validates against the vocabulary
